agency.demo.title: Test tasks
agency.demo.description: Try document previews, approvals and comments.
agency.demo.notice: Six independent examples based on the FLOW templates. Decisions stay on this screen and disappear on refresh. They do not change an order or publish anything.
agency.demo.localResult: This result is local — nothing was sent.
agency.review.description: Review the document, then accept this version or send us your comments.
agency.review.versionHint: You are accepting version {version} only. To request a change, choose Add comments. A new version will need a new approval.
agency.review.pairHint: Strategy and Tone of Voice are separate documents. Content planning starts after both current versions have been accepted.
agency.review.publicationHint: This is a separate consent to publish the post below at the specified destination. Content approval does not grant publication consent.
agency.review.topicLabel: Choose one topic for your post
agency.review.topicPlaceholder: Choose a topic from the plan
agency.review.topicHint: Your approval covers the 12-topic plan and one selected topic for production.
agency.review.commentsPlaceholder: Tell us what to change. You can refer to a specific section of the document.
agency.review.commentsDescription: Comments on {title}, version {version}. We will review them and prepare a reply or a revised version.
agency.review.accepted: Your decision has been sent and is awaiting processing.
agency.review.commentsSent: Your comments have been sent. We will notify you when a reply or a new version is ready.
agency.review.stale: This version needs review or has been replaced. Please wait for the current document.
agency.review.readOnly: This document is available for viewing. No decision is required from you right now.
agency.review.submitError: We could not confirm receipt of your request. Your comments remain in the dialog. Please try again.
agency.review.invalid: This document is not ready for review. Its content or version details are missing.
agency.materials.title: Materials
agency.materials.description: Send material to your agency. This does not create an order or confirm payment.
agency.materials.success: Material received and processed. Your agency can now view the case.
agency.materials.invalid: Enter a title and choose a non-empty material file.
agency.materials.unlinked: Your account must be linked to a customer before submitting material.
